data.one_liner: Control size, position, and appearance of desktop windows in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter API to resize, move, show, hide and decorate windows on Windows, macOS and Linux. It wraps the nativeapi core so no platform‑specific plugin code is required.
use_when: You need custom window chrome or frameless windows
Your app uses multiple desktop windows
You want to programmatically control window size, position, or visibility
avoid_when: Targeting mobile, web, or embedded platforms
You only need simple window behavior provided by the OS
strengths: No native setup required beyond GTK dev packages on Linux
Rich API for multi‑window, title‑bar styles, and events
weaknesses: Desktop‑only; not usable on mobile or web
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency and, on Linux, install GTK3/X11/Xi dev packages (e.g., sudo apt-get install libgtk-3-dev libx11-dev libxi-dev).

alternatives.name: win32
alternatives.why_pick_it: Low‑level Windows‑only API when you only need Windows support and prefer direct Win32 calls
